title: Optimal Anti-Thrombotic Management Following Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion
official: Optimal Anti-Thrombotic Management Following Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (INTEGRAL)
summary: This randomized study was designed to compare two antithrombotic regimens (long-term half-dose apixaban vs long-term aspirin after 45-days of full-dose apixaban) after successful Watchman implantation.

sites.f: Texas Cardiac Arrhythmia Institute, St. David's Medical Center
